gloss: edge of a cliff; critical moment

definitions.gloss: edge of a cliff; brink of a precipice
definitions.explanation: The physical edge of a cliff or steep drop-off.

definitions.gloss: critical moment; last chance; do-or-die situation
definitions.explanation: A figurative sense meaning a desperate or make-or-break situation where failure seems imminent.

examples.japanese: {崖|がけ}っぷち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: I stood at the edge of the cliff.

examples.japanese: {崖|がけ}っぷち⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すくんだ→すくむ：10356_sukumu⟧。
examples.english: When I looked down from the cliff edge, my legs froze.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{崖|がけ}っぷち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}づかない→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{柵|さく}→柵：13103_saku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設|もう}けられた→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: A fence was set up so that children wouldn't approach the cliff edge.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{崖|がけ}っぷち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}い{込|こ}まれた→追い込む：06371_oikomu⟧。
examples.english: The team was pushed to the brink.

examples.japanese: {崖|がけ}っぷち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{奇跡|きせき}→奇跡：09935_kiseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: They pulled off a miraculous comeback in a do-or-die situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{崖|がけ}っぷち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}たされて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{投資家|とうしか}→投資家：16242_toushika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{持|も}ち{直|なお}した→持ち直す：08203_mochinaosu⟧。
examples.english: The company was on the brink of collapse, but recovered thanks to a new investor.

notes:
{崖|がけ}っぷち literally means the edge (⟦{淵|ふち}→淵：13456_fuchi⟧) of a cliff (⟦{崖|がけ}→崖：05391_gake⟧). The っぷち is a colloquial contraction of ぶち, from ⟦{淵|ふち}→淵：13456_fuchi⟧.

The figurative sense is far more common in everyday use, describing desperate situations where one is about to fail or lose everything.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {崖|がけ}っぷち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand at the brink)
- {崖|がけ}っぷち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}い{込|こ}まれる→追い込む：06371_oikomu⟧ (to be driven to the brink)
- {崖|がけ}っぷち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧ (a do-or-die situation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{瀬戸際|せとぎわ}→瀬戸際：10554_setogiwa⟧: critical moment, turning point — more formal, used in serious contexts like diplomacy or life-and-death matters
- ⟦{土壇場|どたんば}→土壇場：10555_dotanba⟧: the last moment — emphasizes being at the very end with no more time
